notes: Batch 24 CLOSED. Full narrative in docs/journey-runs/BATCH_24_RESULTS.md. Summary of the full arc: (1) initial fresh execution found 20 PASS/PRODUCT_GAP and used an RPC fallback for T-010-T-018 after browser click delivery degraded mid-batch; (2) a bounded evidence sanity check (Utkarsh) correctly found the RPC fallback was over-applied beyond its approved concurrency-only scope, reclassifying T-010, T-011, T-012, T-013, T-016, T-017, T-018 to PARTIAL and S-024 was closed as a genuine defect (malformed/display-id 500 on two /api/v1 detail routes, found and fixed via the existing isValidUuid guard, same root cause as the already-fixed S-013); (3) browser tooling recovered and all 7 PARTIAL journeys were retested with genuine end-user-session evidence (T-010 through T-013), while T-016/T-017/T-018 surfaced a real architectural finding: no canonical persona holding team.write could reach any UI surface for team membership management, since the only such surface (/settings/user-access) is gated on user_access.read, which only the user_access_admin role grants (bundled with user_access.write). This affected T-015 too (its Recovery Variant assumes a persona that could not exist). Both reclassified PRODUCT_GAP_CONFIRMED; (4) Utkarsh made Product Decision PD-009 (docs/AUTHORIZATION_MODEL.md section 25): team.write must remain independently delegable from user_access.write, implemented via a new Team Membership section on the existing /settings/teams page (gated on the pre-existing team.read/team.write, no Server Action changed, least-privilege composer that never receives role data); (5) genuine manual UI verification performed personally by Utkarsh after the agent's own browser automation hit a reproducible, fully-documented click-delivery limitation on this Select's popup positioning (disclosed, not worked around); the agent independently verified every consequence via direct DB query afterward (grant created and correctly attributed, revoked and correctly attributed, historical row preserved, affected user's eligibility and role/activation state unchanged, Team Admin's own permissions unchanged). T-015 and T-016 are tracked as PASS in this JSON schema (no PRODUCT_GAP_RESOLVED enum key exists in scripts/journey-status.mjs; per the Journey Discovery Execution Protocol's own guidance, no new dashboard schema was invented for this), with the full PRODUCT_GAP_CONFIRMED -> PD-009 -> PRODUCT_GAP_RESOLVED narrative preserved in BATCH_24_RESULTS.md and AUTHORIZATION_MODEL.md section 25. Journey Discovery for the PD-009 fix itself found 7 ALREADY_COVERED dimensions (positive path, idempotency, historical preservation, concurrency, deactivated-team exclusion, direct-action bypass design intent), 1 FUTURE_MODULE (a hypothetical team.read-only-without-write persona does not exist in this schema today), 0 new journeys required. Batch 24 is now fully evidence-clean: 0 PARTIAL, 0 BLOCKED, 0 open defects, 0 open Product Decisions. Do not start Batch 31. Batch 25 begins next, pending explicit authorization.
